---
title: "Reactance Calculator"
---

This plot shows the intersection of Capacitive ($X_C$) and Inductive ($X_L$) Reactance across a frequency sweep.

```{python}


import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

f = np.linspace(10, 1000, 500)
C = 100e-6  
L = 10e-3   

X_C = 1 / (2 * np.pi * f * C)
X_L = 2 * np.pi * f * L

plt.figure(figsize=(9, 6))
plt.plot(f, X_C, label='Capacitive Reactance')
plt.plot(f, X_L, label='Inductive Reactance')

plt.title('Reactance vs Frequency')
plt.xlabel('Frequency (Hz)')
plt.ylabel('Reactance (Ohms)')
plt.ylim(0, 100)
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend()
plt.show()

```
